notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 50-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.72, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 14.5, platelets 287, sodium 138, wbc 6.8; vitals dbp 69-73, heart_rate 69-74, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 126-133, spo2 95-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.96, hemoglobin 14.6, platelets 292, sodium 138, wbc 6.7; vitals dbp 68-73, heart_rate 69-74, map 87-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 126-132, spo2 95-96, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 50-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
